meta.description: Generate multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) for protein sequences using the ColabFold MSA-Search NIM. Use for homolog search, UniRef30/ColabFold env searches, A3M or FASTA alignments, paired MSA search for complexes, PDB70 structural templates, hosted NVIDIA API calls, or local Docker deployment. For local deployment, download the databases in parallel with aria2c and launch via NIM_MODEL_NAME (the recommended default fast path, ~14 min vs over 80 min for the built-in downloader).

key_strengths: Exceptional performance optimization: parallel download with aria2c reduces setup from 80+ minutes to 14 minutes with detailed rationale
Comprehensive coverage: standard MSA, paired MSA for complexes, and structural template search with clear endpoint distinctions
Strong task-specific guidance: database profile table with storage requirements and use-case recommendations
Robust deployment strategy: default fast path (aria2c + NIM_MODEL_NAME) vs fallback (built-in downloader) clearly distinguished
Clear scientific handoffs: A3M output compatibility with OpenFold3/AlphaFold2/RoseTTAFold documented

recommendations.title: Refactor parallel download mechanics to reference file
recommendations.problem: 373-line SKILL.md significantly exceeds 250-line target; parallel download rationale and loop add ~70 lines
recommendations.root_cause: Performance optimization critical but detailed mechanics inflate main file
recommendations.fix: Create references/database-setup.md covering aria2c rationale (80min vs 14min), NGC API file listing, download loop, and NIM_MODEL_NAME bypass; keep 3-5 line summary in SKILL.md Local Docker section with pointer to full guide

recommendations.title: Add recovery guidance for presigned URL expiration
recommendations.problem: Presigned URLs expire within ~1 day but no explicit recovery steps if URLs expire mid-download or before completion
recommendations.root_cause: Expiration mentioned as caution but failure scenario not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add to Troubleshooting: 'aria2c fails with 403/404 on some files → presigned URLs expired. Re-fetch files.json with NGC API call and rebuild aria2 input file. Use aria2c --continue to resume from existing partial downloads without re-downloading completed files.'

recommendations.title: Elevate hosted template restriction to hard constraint
recommendations.problem: Hosted template endpoint 404 mentioned in Choose Mode as observation but not in decision tree or hard rules
recommendations.root_cause: Endpoint unavailability discovered during validation but not formalized as constraint
recommendations.fix: Add to Choose Mode: 'Template search requires local Docker — hosted template endpoint returned 404 in validation and should not be assumed available. If user requests hosted templates, explain limitation and redirect to local deployment.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for MSA generation
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running MSA search with same sequence produces identical alignments
recommendations.root_cause: Determinism via e_value threshold assumed but not documented
recommendations.fix: Add to Limits: 'MSA search is deterministic: same sequence, databases, and e_value produce identical alignments across runs. However, database versions change over time (e.g., Uniref30_2302 vs newer releases) affecting results. Version database names in documentation for reproducibility.'
